meta.title: Spolu Vpred — Workshops for Schools | OZ Spolu Vpred
meta.description: The civic association Spolu Vpred runs interactive workshops and prevention activities for primary and secondary schools. We help young people better understand themselves, others and the world around them.

about.title: Young people deserve a space where they can ask, explore and grow.
about.paragraph1: Spolu Vpred is a civic association based in Bratislava. We design interactive workshops and prevention activities for primary and secondary schools — on the topics that matter to young people and shape their everyday lives: from relationships in the classroom and mental health to responsibility towards society and nature.
about.paragraph2: We don't believe in lectures where students sit passively. Our workshops are built on experience, play, discussion and first-hand practice. Students take part, try things out, think and find their own answers — at a pace and in a language that fits their age.

participation.title: Active participation over passive lectures
participation.text: Students are not an audience. They discuss, play, create and solve tasks that make the topics truly stick.

skills.title: Practical skills for real life
skills.text: We teach what young people can use right away: how to say no, how to spot disinformation, how to ask for help and how to handle speaking in front of the class.

safeSpace.title: A safe space for questions and critical thinking
safeSpace.text: Every question is welcome. We create a judgement-free environment where even difficult topics can be discussed openly.

workshops.title: Pick a topic worth talking about
workshops.lead: We tailor every workshop to the age and needs of the students. Can't find what you're looking for? Write to us — we'd love to talk.
workshops.emptyText: Try a different keyword or choose another category.

bullying.title: A Safe School Without Bullying
bullying.description: How to recognise bullying, why it happens and what each of us can do — the target, the bystander and the whole class. Through situational exercises we look for ways to make everyone feel safe in the group and online.

wellbeing.title: Mental Wellbeing
wellbeing.description: How to look after your mental wellbeing, cope with stress and pressure at school and recognise when it is time to ask for help. No taboos, and with practical everyday techniques.

critical.title: Think Critically
critical.description: How to find your way through a world of information, spot disinformation and manipulation, and check your sources. We practise the questions to ask before believing something or passing it on.

nature.title: Responsibly Towards Nature
nature.description: What does our behaviour have to do with the state of the planet? Hands-on activities about protecting nature, sustainability and the small steps each of us can take at home and at school.

respect.title: Respect and Tolerance
respect.description: We learn to listen, accept differences and respect other opinions and ways of life. The workshop builds empathy and open dialogue in the classroom.

trafficking.title: Human Trafficking Prevention
trafficking.description: How to recognise warning signs, the risks of fake job offers and manipulation — and how to protect yourself. Factual, sensitive and age-appropriate.

homelessness.title: Homelessness Prevention
homelessness.description: Why do people end up without a home? We bust myths and prejudices, build empathy and show how even a young person can help.

racism.title: Racism Prevention
racism.description: How prejudice and stereotypes form, how racism shows up and how to stand up to it. We strengthen equality, solidarity and fair treatment for everyone.

extremism.title: Extremism Prevention
extremism.description: What extremism is, how extremist groups recruit and why democratic values matter. We encourage responsible citizenship and the ability to say no.

assertive.title: How to Communicate Assertively
assertive.description: How to say what I feel and need without putting myself or others down. Practice in setting boundaries and saying no in hands-on role-play situations.

digital.title: Digital with Sense
digital.description: How to use your phone, social media and games in a healthy way. We talk about screen time, online pressure and keeping a balance between the online and offline worlds.

speaking.title: Public Speaking and Presenting Without Fear
speaking.description: How to handle stage fright, structure a talk and speak in front of others with confidence. Plenty of practice in a safe environment where everyone can succeed.

schools.title: Workshops tailored to your class
schools.text: For teachers, principals and prevention coordinators: we adapt workshops to the students' age and to the topic you are working on right now. Just write to us — together we'll fine-tune the topic, scope and date.
points: Open discussion in a safe environment

volunteering.title: Join us
volunteering.text: We are happy to welcome people who want to do something meaningful for young people. If you'd like to help with workshops, organisation or communication, write to us and we'll figure out together where you can get involved.
points: A team that supports each other
